title: Only 1% Solve These 3 Brain Riddles!
hook: Why does nobody explain 13 Riddles That Will Test like this?
script:
Only 1% of people can crack all three of these mind-bending riddles. Are you up to the challenge? Let's find out! Get ready for three quick questions, each with a short timer. Don't blink, and think fast!

Riddle number one: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
[5-second timer]
Time's up! The answer is an echo. Did you get that one?

Riddle number two: What has to be broken before you can use it?
[5-second timer]
Pencils down! The answer is an egg. Simple, but tricky, right?

And for our final riddle: What is full of holes but still holds water?
[5-second timer]
That's the buzzer! The answer is a sponge.

How did you do? Did you join the elite 1%? Ready for another round to prove you're in that top 1%?
comment: How many riddles did you solve? Let us know your score!
